`chrome-devtools-mcp-1.13.0.json` contains the public tool catalog emitted by
Chrome DevTools MCP 1.13.0, with the broker's structured-content and interop flags.
It is used to check the pinned schema dialect and context budgets without
starting a worker. The response envelope was removed; tool definitions are
unchanged.

`uidless-snapshot-nodes.json` is a `take_snapshot` result from Chrome DevTools
MCP 1.13.0 on a signed-in healthchecks.io page, with account names, IDs and the
email address replaced. Its icon-font StaticText nodes have no uid.

Source: https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/tree/chrome-devtools-mcp-v1.13.0
